## What changes

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and any remaining limitations.

## Release notes

Note user-visible features, fixes, and breaking changes. Use a Conventional
Commit PR title (for example `feat: add overlay controls`) so the squash commit
is included in the generated release notes. Include a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer
in the squash commit body when applicable.
